newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr hovers near 114 yen after sharp drop on tankan.
newsitem.headline: Dlr hovers near 114 yen after sharp drop on tankan.

text.p: *Dollar hovering near 114 yen after falling around one yen due to stronger-than-expected figures in Bank of Japan's "tankan" quarterly survey.
*Short-covering and purchases by Japanese investors quickly pushed dollar above 114 yen from earlier low of 113.78 yen.
*Mark sales for yen, probably by exporters, indirectly weighing on dollar/yen.
*Key diffusion index for major manufacturers in June tankan was plus seven, up from plus two in March and higher than analysts' forecasts which ranged from minus four to plus four.
*Mark was quoted at 66.01/04 yen at 0119 GMT, down from 66.64 yen at Tuesday's New York close.

*Some dealers said there may be a chance that the Bank of Japan will raise interest rates in the autumn after seeing strong tankan data, but others were still sceptical about an imminent credit-tightening because of the weak diffusion index (DI) for small manufacturers.
*DI for small manufacturers improved just slightly in June to minus seven from minus eight in March, but is forecast to fall to minus eight again in September.

*Masayuki Matsushima, director of the central bank's Research and Statistics Department, told a news conference that the result of the tankan was in line with the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) assessment of Japan's economic recovery.
*He added that a rise in exports helped improve sentiment among big manufacturers and that correction of yen weakness had no major impact on overall corporate sentiment.
*U.S. operators were also buying dollars for yen near 113.80 yen, supporting the greenback, a dealer at a European bank said.
*Dollar fell nearly one yen from late New York level in early Tokyo after stronger-than-expected Bank of Japan tankan.
*Interbank players rushed to set up new dollar shorts after the tankan, traders said.
*Dollar could slide further to around 113.50 yen, but buying interest from Japanese institutional investors likely to provide support at around 113 yen, a trader at another trust bank said.
